eval_results.reference_sql: WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(rev) AS grand_total FROM cat_rev) SELECT cr.category_name, ROUND(cr.rev, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * cr.rev / tr.grand_total, 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM cat_rev cr CROSS JOIN total_rev tr ORDER BY cr.rev DESC LIMIT 3;

eval_results.question: What is the average discount given on completed orders where total amount exceeds 1000 dollars versus under 1000 dollars?
eval_results.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.total_amount >= 1000 THEN 'Large Order (>= $1000)' ELSE 'Standard Order (< $1000)' END AS order_size, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY order_size ORDER BY avg_discount_rate DESC;

eval_results.question: Find the most reliable payment method: lowest failed transaction count and highest total successful settlement.
eval_results.reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'successful' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS settled_volume FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY settled_volume DESC;
